review_description: Alan from Neater Energy responded promptly to our request for a quote and met with us to talk through key considerations, and also researched additional options and gave helpful and responsive advice to help design the system to best suit our site and particular circumstances. Chris our installer was very professional and meticulous in his work. Neater Energy did an on site review of the installation, and assisted us with preparing and lodging paperwork with our retailer and distributor. We have been very satisfied with the service that Neater Energy provided to us and would recommend them to others.
Easy and fuss free installation. Good knowledge on products and provides excellent suggestions on installation to obtain the best possible solar efficiency.

Almost did not get to install the system on my roof due to the steep pitch. Neater Energy continued to persist and found the right crew to make it all possible. The service and support is exceptional. One cannot fault their commitment to the job. More power to Neater Energy!
